items.title: 最有火藥味時刻將至！聯合國大會辯論今登場  美伊總統同台會否攤牌？
items.title_en: The Most Explosive Moment Is Near! UN General Assembly Debate Kicks Off Today – Will the US and Iranian Presidents Face Off?
paras: 第81屆聯合國大會一般性辯論將在美東時間周二(22日)在紐約總部揭幕，為期一週的「世界領袖峰會」預計吸引近130位國家元首或政府首長登台，聯合國統計約118位將出席一般性辯論及高級別周活動，其餘由高官代表。
在地緣政治衝突與AI治理雙主線夾擊下，今年聯大會場上不僅是觀點交鋒的講壇，更是大國與全球南方密集磋商、測試多邊主義修復力的「超級外交場」。
按慣例，巴西總統魯拉首日率先發言。巴西帶頭源自聯合國成立初期各國不願首開口、巴西代表常自願出面，日久成制；美國身為東道國排第二。
魯拉行前放話，將在紐約當面要求美國總統川普勿介入巴西選舉，「巴西只有一個主人：巴西人民」。川普則將緊接著魯拉發表談話，美國駐聯大代表Mike Waltz稱重點包括伊朗問題及川普已促成或推動的和平協議。
中東與歐亞兩組「交戰方」行程最受矚目。伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚獲美方簽證，預計周三(23日)發言。美國國務院稱伊朗團隊規模小於去年並受行動限制，這是美伊交戰近七個月來，伊朗首次在最權威的多邊舞台系統陳情。
以色列總理尼坦雅胡也安排周三發言，去年多國代表在其演說時集體離席，今年是否重演退場一幕仍是懸念。
巴勒斯坦總統阿巴斯因美國延長拒簽，連兩年無法親赴紐約。聯大上周四(17日)以152票贊成、3票反對、4票棄權通過決議，允許阿巴斯以預錄影片或視訊發言，預計在周四(24日)播出。
此外，烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基安排周三、俄羅斯外長拉夫羅夫排在周六(26日)，雙方同台不同日，仍構成俄烏敘事對撞。
議題方面，今年明顯收斂為地緣與AI兩條主軸。聯合國《2026年全球風險報告》顯示，大規模衝突風險排名較2024年調查躍升16位；中東因美伊戰事、荷姆茲與曼德海峽通航受擾，油價與供應鏈波動向外擴散，巴以、加薩人道、葉門與紅海、黑海糧運一併被捆成綜合危機。
分析普遍認為，中東將是一般性辯論最熱戰場，各國能否把停火、航道安全與「兩國方案」納入同一政治路徑，直接檢驗聯合國調解能力。
AI則首次跟傳統安全並列核心討論議題。聯合國安理會周三舉行AI與安全高級別會議。秘書長古特雷斯此前把失控AI列為人類「三大生存威脅」之首，其他兩個為氣候危機與不平等擴大，呼籲具前沿能力的國家建立溝通機制與「共同護欄」，避免安全標準逐底競爭。
美國則傾向鬆綁監管、維持自願審查，與古特雷斯路線形成反差；本屆聯大料將延續「創新不等於無序」的規則博弈，並把深偽、自主武器、算力集中與全球南方接入差距納入文本談判。
除講台外，場邊會晤與雙邊會談才是真正變數。川普預計會見波斯灣六國領導人或外長，牽動美伊戰爭下一步與後中東秩序；美伊若無直接會談，也可能經第三方傳話。此外，在美國今年初突襲委內瑞拉、強擄總統馬杜洛後，川普擬與委國代理總統羅德里格斯舉行「邊廊會談」，為十餘年來首次美委領導層面對面。
美英、美日亦安排領袖會面，英國首相伯納姆、日相高市早苗均屬聯大首秀；中英、中法、加拿大、越南、印尼及全球南方中等強國活動密度上升，北韓則續派副外相金仙景與會。
消息人士透露，尼坦雅胡、澤倫斯基未列入川普會客名單，凸顯以伊、俄烏兩線短期難由峰會破局。

北京外國語大學區域與全球治理高等研究院教授崔洪建指出，聯大是個多元平台，重在平衡發展與安全。近年地緣衝突與經濟競爭並起，聯合國權威受挑戰，永續發展「欠帳」擴大。他認為，中美關係若延續緩和，可改善整體氛圍；俄烏、美以伊雖戰火未息，但各方試提政治方案，本屆辯論有望為全球治理改革提供契機。中國角色亦受期待，其倡議與聯合國憲章契合，未踐踏國際法，與大國關係相對平衡，可繼續以提供公共產品、穩定大國關係、推動發展議程方式發揮作用。
制度層面，古特雷斯第二任期年底屆滿，新秘書長2027年1月接任；本屆已舉行候選人公開對話，巴切萊特、格羅西、格林斯潘、薩勒、埃斯皮諾薩、甘巴等人角逐，發展中國家代表性、決策效率、財政與維和改革成核心。
從巴西開場到地緣政治議程，第81屆聯大既要處置戰爭，也要為AI立規，能否把「重建信任、管理變革」的主題轉成決議與行動，將決定這個1945年體系在多元世界中的下一次合法性。
paras_en: The 81st UN General Assembly's general debate will open on Tuesday (the 22nd) Eastern US time at the New York headquarters, launching a week-long "World Leaders Summit" expected to draw nearly 130 heads of state or government. UN statistics show about 118 will attend the general debate and high‑level week events, with the rest represented by senior officials.

Against the twin pressures of geopolitical conflict and AI governance, this year's GA floor will be more than a platform for clashing viewpoints; it will serve as a "super‑diplomacy arena" where major powers and the Global South engage intensively and test the resilience of multilateralism.

As usual, Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula will speak first on day one. Brazil’s lead stems from the early UN era when many nations were reluctant to be the first speaker, and Brazilian delegations often volunteered, making it a tradition; the United States, as host, follows second.

Lula has said he will use his New York appearance to demand that U.S. President Donald Trump stay out of Brazil’s elections, stating “Brazil has only one master: the Brazilian people.” Trump will speak immediately after Lula, and U.S. UN ambassador Mike Waltz said his remarks will focus on Iran and peace agreements that Trump has helped broker or promote.

The Middle‑East and Eurasian “combatants” draw the most attention. Iranian President Ebrahim Raisi has obtained a U.S. visa and is expected to speak on Wednesday (the 23rd). The State Department says the Iranian team will be smaller than last year’s and subject to movement restrictions, marking Iran’s first appearance on the most authoritative multilateral stage in nearly seven months of U.S.–Iran hostilities.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is also slated to speak on Wednesday; last year multiple delegations walked out during his address, and it remains uncertain whether a similar walk‑out will occur this time.

Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas has been unable to travel to New York for two years due to a U.S. visa denial extension. The GA on Thursday (the 17th) passed a resolution 152‑3‑4 allowing Abbas to address the assembly via pre‑recorded video or video link, with his remarks expected to be broadcast on Thursday (the 24th).

In addition, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is scheduled for Wednesday, while Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov is set for Saturday (the 26th). Though they will not share the same day, their separate appearances continue the narrative clash between Russia and Ukraine.

On issues, this year’s debate has clearly narrowed to two main strands: geopolitics and AI. The UN’s 2026 Global Risks Report shows the risk ranking for large‑scale conflict has jumped 16 places since the 2024 survey; turmoil in the Middle East over U.S.–Iran fighting, the Hormuz Strait and the Strait of Malacca is sending oil‑price and supply‑chain volatility outward, bundling the Israel‑Palestine, Gaza humanitarian, Yemen, Red Sea and Black Sea grain‑shipping crises into a single compound emergency.

Analysts widely believe the Middle East will be the hottest battlefield of the general debate, and whether nations can fold cease‑fire, shipping‑lane security and a two‑state solution into a single political pathway will directly test the UN’s mediation capacity.

AI is for the first time placed on equal footing with traditional security as a core discussion topic. The UN Security Council will hold a high‑level meeting on AI and security on Wednesday. Secretary‑General António Guterres has previously listed uncontrolled AI as the top of humanity’s three "existential threats," alongside climate crisis and widening inequality, urging technologically advanced countries to set up communication mechanisms and a "joint guardrail" to prevent a race‑to‑the‑bottom in safety standards.

The United States, by contrast, favors loosening regulation and maintaining voluntary review, diverging from Guterres’ line; this GA is expected to continue the rule‑game of "innovation does not equal disorder" and to embed issues such as deepfakes, autonomous weapons, concentration of computing power and the digital divide with the Global South into the text negotiations.

Beyond the podium, side meetings and bilateral talks are the real variables. Trump is expected to meet leaders or foreign ministers of the six Gulf states, a move that could shape the next steps of the U.S.–Iran war and the post‑Middle‑East order; if there is no direct U.S.–Iran dialogue, messages may still be passed via a third party. Moreover, after the U.S. raid on Venezuela earlier this year and the forced removal of President Nicolás Maduro, Trump plans a "corridor meeting" with Venezuelan interim President Diosdado Cabello Rodríguez, marking the first face‑to‑face between U.S. and Venezuelan leadership in over a decade.

The U.K. and Japan also have leader‑level meetings scheduled; British Prime Minister Rishi Sunak and Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida will make their GA debuts. Activity is rising among China‑U.K., China‑France, Canada, Vietnam, Indonesia and other medium‑strength Global South players, while North Korea continues to send Deputy Foreign Minister Kim Seong‑kyung.
Sources indicate that Netanyahu and Zelenskyy are not on Trump’s guest list, underscoring how the Iran and Russia‑Ukraine tracks are unlikely to be resolved quickly at the summit.

Professor Cui Hongjian of Beijing Foreign Studies University’s Institute for Regional and Global Governance notes that the GA is a pluralistic platform aimed at balancing development and security. With concurrent geopolitical conflicts and economic competition, UN authority is being challenged and the sustainability “account deficit” is widening. He believes that if U.S.–China relations remain on a cooling path, the overall atmosphere could improve; although the Russia‑Ukraine, U.S.–Israel‑Iran wars continue, all sides are proposing political solutions, and this debate could provide a chance for global‑governance reform. China’s role is also watched closely; its initiatives align with the UN Charter, do not violate international law, and maintain a relatively balanced relationship with major powers, allowing it to continue contributing public goods, stabilising great‑power relations and advancing the development agenda.

Institutionally, Guterres’ second term ends at the end of the year and a new secretary‑general will take office in January 2027. This GA has already held public candidate dialogues, with contenders such as Bachelet, Grossi, Greenspan, Salé, Espinosa, Gamba and others vying for the post, focusing on representation of developing countries, decision‑making efficiency, financing and peace‑keeping reform as core issues.

From Brazil’s opening to the geopolitics agenda, the 81st GA must both manage wars and set rules for AI; whether it can turn the theme of “rebuilding trust and managing change” into concrete resolutions and actions will determine the next legitimacy of the 1945 system in an increasingly diverse world.

items.title: Meta爆發撐起AI變現信心 「科技七巨頭」強勢大反攻
items.title_en: Meta Surge Fuels Confidence in AI Monetization as the "Magnificent Seven" Tech Giants Launch Strong Counterattack
paras: 「科技七巨頭」(Magnificent Seven)正捲土重來，Meta(META-US)單日飆升11.43%，因其最新人工智慧(AI)助理Muse躍居蘋果App Store排行榜首位，這不但幫助延續科技股漲勢，也讓市場暫時把近來對AI安全的恐慌情緒拋到腦後。
Meta股價周一(21日)大漲11%，創下逾一年來最大單日漲幅，市值增加1920億美元，與「科技七巨頭」相關的ETF也因此創下5月以來首見歷史新高。

Meta重燃AI投資信心

華爾街一度將Meta視為AI投資交易中的潛在弱點，理由是難以釐清Meta龐大的資本支出究竟要如何產生回報，但Muse推出後的亮眼表現，似乎替Meta闢出一條新的成長路徑。
Muse是一款在9月8日推出的免費AI助理，專長是執行多步驟任務，例如從不同帳戶尋找資料、填寫網路表單，以及協商並完成線上購物。Muse基本版免費提供給使用者，另針對重度使用者提供付費方案。
Truist分析師Youssef Squali表示，Muse是Meta多年來最重要的消費者產品，並稱這是「迄今最明確打造非廣告營收來源的嘗試」。
不只Meta大漲，「科技七巨頭」其餘六家公司周一股價也全部收紅。華爾街重新燃起的AI樂觀情緒進一步帶動資料中心開發商及供應商股價，英特爾(INTC-US)股價上漲12%，超微(AMD-US)大漲10%、市值首度突破1兆美元，成為第14家達到這個里程碑的美國企業。
投資人風險胃納甚至擴大至比特幣，比特幣延續近期漲勢，周一一度觸及約8.6萬美元，創1月以來新高。相關概念股同步走高，Strategy(MSTR-US)大漲9.5%。
Hirtle & Co.投資長Brad Conger表示，即使通膨持續高漲，且聯準會(Fed)未來幾個月持續升息，短期內可能仍不足以壓抑這波AI狂熱推動的股市行情。他說：「唯一能得出的結論，就是股市正在消化這些因素。」
paras_en: The "Magnificent Seven" tech giants are making a comeback, with Meta (META-US) jumping 11.43% in a single day after its new AI assistant Muse topped Apple’s App Store chart, a boost that not only sustains the rally in tech stocks but also temporarily pushes recent AI‑safety fears out of investors’ minds.

Meta’s shares surged about 11% on Monday the 21st, marking the biggest single‑day gain in over a year and adding $192 billion to its market value; ETFs linked to the "Magnificent Seven" also hit a fresh all‑time high for May.

Meta rekindles AI investment confidence. Wall Street had once viewed Meta as a potential weak spot in AI‑related trades because it was unclear how the company’s massive capital spending would generate returns, but the strong performance of Muse appears to open a new growth path for Meta.

Muse is a free AI assistant launched on September 8 that excels at multi‑step tasks such as pulling data from different accounts, filling out online forms, and negotiating and completing e‑commerce purchases. The basic version is free for users, with a paid tier for heavy users.
Truist analyst Youssef Squali said Muse is Meta’s most important consumer product in years and called it “the clearest attempt yet to build a non‑advertising revenue stream.”

Not only did Meta rally, all six of the other Magnificent Seven stocks closed higher on Monday. Renewed AI optimism on Wall Street also lifted data‑center developers and suppliers, with Intel (INTC-US) up 12% and AMD (AMD-US) soaring 10% as its market cap broke the $1 trillion mark for the first time, becoming the 14th U.S. company to reach that milestone.

Investors’ risk appetite even expanded to Bitcoin, which continued its recent climb and briefly touched about $86,000 on Monday, a new high since January. Related theme stocks rose as well, with MicroStrategy (MSTR-US) jumping 9.5%.

Hirtle & Co. chief investment officer Brad Conger said that even with persistently high inflation and the Fed likely to keep raising rates over the next few months, those factors may not be enough in the short term to curb the AI‑driven market rally. He added, “The only conclusion we can draw is that the market is digesting these factors.”

items.title: Meta Muse走紅擴大AI商業化想像，算力與基礎設施供應鏈需求受關注
items.title_en: Meta Muse Gains Popularity, Expanding AI Commercialization Prospects and Highlighting Demand for Compute and Infrastructure Supply Chains
paras: 2026年09月22日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ Meta Platforms(META-US)推出面向消費者的個人AI Agent Muse後迅速獲得市場關注。瑞銀(UBS)策略分析師認為，Muse受到消費者歡迎，顯示AI應用正從企業市場進一步向消費端擴散，除了為AI業者開拓新的商業化模式，也可能帶動運算資源與AI基礎設施需求成長，進一步擴大半導體與硬體供應鏈商機。
Meta於9月8日正式推出Muse，與傳統以問答為主的AI聊天機器人不同，Muse不只是回應使用者問題，而是能根據使用者設定的目標，自主規劃並執行任務，包括寄送電子郵件、安排行程、比價與購物等。產品上市兩週下載量已突破250萬次，一度升至美國App Store下載排行榜第2名，顯示消費者對能夠直接代為執行工作的AI Agent已有初步需求。
商業模式方面，Meta除了提供免費版本，也推出每月20美元及100美元兩種付費方案，每週使用上限分別為5億及30億token。目前Muse僅在美國市場推出，支援iOS、Android與Muse網站，也能透過WhatsApp使用，未來並規劃延伸至Meta的AI眼鏡。

華爾街也開始評估Muse可能帶來的財務效益。Wells Fargo將Meta目標價由640美元調升至796美元，維持「增持」評級。Wedbush則估計，Muse於2027年的訂閱收入可能達約50億美元，占其對Meta總營收預估約1.5%，但認為短期變現潛力仍相對有限。Oppenheimer 則指出 Meta 的信任度偏低，調查顯示僅 8% 的美國消費者願意將密碼託付給 Meta，遠低於 Google 的 30%、Apple 的 23% 和 ChatGPT 的 16%，這可能限制 Muse 的採用率
這項轉變也可能改變AI運算需求結構。當AI從單純回答問題，進一步轉向能持續規劃、呼叫工具並跨服務執行任務的AI Agent，單一任務背後可能涉及更多模型推論、任務調度及資料處理，使AI基礎設施需求不再只集中於大型模型訓練，也逐步延伸至推論及AI Agent相關運算。

UBS strategy analysts said Muse’s popularity with consumers shows AI applications are moving beyond the enterprise market into the consumer side, opening new commercialization models for AI firms and potentially driving growth in computing resources and AI infrastructure demand, thereby expanding opportunities for semiconductor and hardware supply chains.

Meta officially launched Muse on September 8. Unlike traditional Q&A‑style chatbots, Muse does more than answer user questions; it can autonomously plan and execute tasks based on user‑defined goals, such as sending emails, scheduling appointments, price‑comparing and shopping. Within two weeks of release, downloads topped 2.5 million, briefly reaching No. 2 on the U.S. App Store chart, indicating an emerging consumer demand for AI agents that can perform work on their behalf.

In terms of business model, Meta offers a free tier and two paid plans – $20 and $100 per month – with weekly usage caps of 5 billion and 30 billion tokens respectively. Muse is currently available only in the United States, supporting iOS, Android, the Muse website, and WhatsApp, with plans to extend to Meta’s AI glasses in the future.

Wall Street is also assessing Muse’s potential financial impact. Wells Fargo raised Meta’s target price from $640 to $796 and kept an “overweight” rating. Wedbush estimates Muse could generate about $5 billion in subscription revenue in 2027, roughly 1.5 % of its projected total revenue for Meta, but notes short‑term monetization potential remains limited. Oppenheimer points out Meta’s low trust levels – a survey shows only 8 % of U.S. consumers would entrust passwords to Meta, far below Google’s 30 %, Apple’s 23 % and ChatGPT’s 16 % – which could curb Muse adoption.

This shift may also alter the structure of AI compute demand. As AI moves from simple question‑answering to agents that continuously plan, invoke tools and execute cross‑service tasks, a single task may involve more model inference, task scheduling and data processing, expanding AI infrastructure needs beyond large‑model training to inference and AI‑agent‑related workloads.

items.title: 川習二會本周華府登場！關稅休戰可望延長 AI安全與300億美元降稅成重頭戲
paras: 美國總統川普與中國國家主席習近平預定本周在華盛頓舉行今年第二次面對面峰會，兩人原本希望強化貿易穩定並取得經濟成果，但圍繞人工智慧(AI)的激烈爭論，加上美國關稅政策變動，以及與伊朗戰爭相關的制裁行動，都可能打亂他們的盤算。
美國財長貝森特(Scott Bessent)周一(21日)受訪時表示，川普與習近平彼此「高度尊重」，這種關係也會延伸至更廣泛的美中談判。不過他隨後指出，近一年前川普與習近平在韓國釜山達成的貿易協議中，「中國有一些應履行的事項尚未完全落實」。

美中談判仍有落差 外交安排引發疑慮

部分中國問題分析師已對美中之間的外交安排提出質疑，表示這次由上而下的程度高度罕見。
戰略暨國際研究中心(CSIS)中國商業與經濟項目資深研究員Claire Reade說：「許多不一致的觀點似乎正彼此拉扯。」她指出，川普主導對中政策的「整體方向」，「同時又讓更多負面行動發生在邊緣地帶」。
此次峰會距離美國選舉周期結束只剩不到六周，而這場選舉的核心議題之一就是美國民眾的生活成本問題。川普在這項關鍵議題上的民調支持度已跌至新低，這讓他更有誘因在與習近平會面後，宣布某種形式的經濟協議。
以下為CNBC整理目前美中貿易關係的狀況，以及川普與習近平會面時面臨的風險：

貿易現況

去年爆發的貿易戰中，美中兩大經濟體把彼此商品關稅推升至驚人水準。美國對中國進口商品的關稅最高一度達145%，北京的報復性關稅則達125%。
2025年5月，兩國在瑞士的貿易談判代表達成臨時協議後，雙方大幅調降關稅，該協議並在2025年8月中旬延長。之後，川普與習近平在釜山達成協議，進一步縮減雙方針鋒相對的貿易措施。
根據這項協議，中國同意暫停對稀土的出口管制，並採購美國農產品，美國則降低部分關稅，並暫停其他貿易報復措施。這項協議有效期原訂為一年，若未延長，將於11月10日到期，也就是美國大選結束的一周過後。
儘管緊張局勢有所降溫，但多項分析顯示，美中目前仍持續對彼此商品課徵高額關稅。
根據賓州大學華頓商學院預算模型，截至7月，美國對中國商品的有效關稅稅率為22.8%，是美國主要貿易夥伴中最高，其中鋼鐵與鋁進口面臨最沉重的關稅。
美國國會研究處(CRS)的估算甚至更高，認為7月美國對中國商品的平均關稅率約為36.5%，高於北京對美國商品課徵的31%。
美中貿易在2025年大幅下滑。美國人口普查局數據顯示，去年兩國商品貿易總額年減近30%，而且2026年前七個月的貿易額仍持續下滑。
不過，中國仍是美國的重要經濟夥伴，貿易規模僅次於墨西哥與加拿大。
川普長期抱怨美國與包括中國在內其他國家存在龐大貿易逆差，同時主張重振美國製造業。今年以來，美國對中國的商品貿易逆差約為912億美元，低於2025年同期，但仍是全球數一數二高的貿易逆差。

市場預期成果有限

川普與習近平上一次會面是5月中旬於北京舉行的國宴，那次峰會場面盛大、排場十足，但最終缺乏具體成果。許多觀察人士預期，這次峰會也可能出現類似結果。
美國銀行全球研究(Bank of America Global Research)中國問題分析師上周在給客戶的報告中表示，美中貿易休戰延長一年是「基本情境」。這代表將維持關稅現狀，並禁止新增出口管制。
分析師表示，中國也可能同意增加採購美國商品，「可能包括更多波音(Boeing)飛機」。在北京峰會後，美中兩國證實中國將採購200架波音飛機，但這個數量低於部分投資人的預期。
美銀分析師表示：「我們預期其他領域的進展有限」，包括擴大先進半導體取得管道的可能性，以及改變目前仍實施中的出口管制。
布魯金斯學會約翰・桑頓中國中心主任Ryan Hass表示，川普與習近平「似乎都在尋求小幅成果，並避免衝突」。
Hass說：「這種不穩定的均衡之所以能夠維持，是因為它對兩位領導人都有兩項功能。首先，這讓兩位領導人都能向國內民眾傳達，他們掌控了與最主要地緣政治競爭對手之間的局勢。其次，這為兩位領導人爭取時間與空間，以降低彼此帶來的依賴與脆弱性。」

美中可能維持關稅休戰

貝森特似乎證實部分上述預測，他周一表示：「我認為我們將維持」關稅休戰。
他補充說，這是他周末與中國國務院副總理何立峰會談的「焦點」，並補充指出，「自去年秋季以來，我們的關係一直非常穩定。」
貝森特也透露，雙方對中國本月稍早提議互降300億美元關稅一事，取得進展，美國貿易代表格里爾(Jamieson Greer)已「將這項提議付諸執行」。
貝森特透露，美方將透過出口農產品、能源以及醫療設備等其他商品來落實協議，中國則「將增加進口更多日常用品」。
不過CSIS的Reade認為，美國可能只希望有限度延長貿易休戰。
Reade表示，這項休戰是美國重要的談判籌碼，而「他們不會希望放棄這項休戰所帶來的籌碼，讓休戰延長到太遙遠的未來」。Reade曾在歐巴馬政府時期擔任美國貿易代表辦公室中國事務助理貿易代表。

AI成核心議題

貝森特也表示，AI將是川普與習近平會談的首要議題，兩人將有許多事情需要討論。
美中目前是這個新興產業的領先國家，而AI在全球經濟中的重要性日益提高。川普認為，AI主導地位與美國經濟優勢密不可分，因此一直大力推動AI基礎設施建設，並主張盡可能減少監管干預。
川普上周在Truth Social發文表示：「一場針對AI與資料中心的惡劣陰謀正在進行，而唯一對此感到高興的就是中國。誰贏得AI，誰就贏得一切！我們領先中國及其他所有國家，而且將繼續保持領先。」
不過，美國部分AI企業負責人近來對先進AI模型發展速度過快可能帶來的災難性風險發出警告。
這些呼籲很快就遭到川普反駁。但川普周一在Truth Social發文表示，如果有必要，政府「將出手控制」，顯示他的立場至少出現些微轉變，從先前較少干預的態度有所收斂，這項變化也可能延伸至與習近平的談判。
貝森特周日表示，他與中國官員討論建立一套對話機制，讓美中兩國能夠互相通報AI相關事件。

對伊朗制裁立場？

川普近期在對伊朗戰爭上的最新行動，也可能影響習近平訪美。美國上個月加強施壓伊朗，目標鎖定協助伊朗進行金融活動的相關對象，這項計畫立即把焦點轉向身為伊朗最大貿易夥伴的中國。
川普政府表示，沒有任何國家可以豁免於潛在制裁，但目前尚未直接將制裁矛頭指向北京。
貝森特周一告訴CNBC，周末與中國官員會談時「確實」討論了相關制裁。他說：「私下在幕後進行討論，比公開展示分歧更好。」他並補充，中國金融主管機關「一直非常積極參與」。

美中企業高層齊聚 川普準備盛大國宴

與北京峰會類似，這次也有多名頂尖企業高層加入相關活動。

一名美國高級官員上周告訴記者，本周四國宴的企業執行長嘉賓將包括亞馬遜(AMZN-US)創辦人貝佐斯(Jeff Bezos)、特斯拉(TSLA-US)與SpaceX(SPCX-US)執行長馬斯克、Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)執行長皮查伊(Sundar Pichai)、戴爾科技(DELL-US)執行長戴爾(Michael Dell)，以及蘋果(AAPL-US)董事長庫克(Tim Cook)。
CNBC先前報導，摩根大通(JPMorgan Chase)(J[M-US)執行長戴蒙(Jamie Dimon)、花旗集團(Citigroup)(C-US)執行長Jane Fraser、輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳(Jensen Huang)及OpenAI執行長奧特曼(Sam Altman)也預定出席。
一些跡象顯示，川普正為這位中國領導人準備一場盛大國宴。據悉習近平抵達白宮後將有多項儀式，包括美國海軍陸戰隊在白宮南草坪向習近平致敬，接著在玫瑰園舉行軍事閱兵，並安排屋頂號角手演奏，最後以多架軍機飛越上空作結。
美國第一夫人梅蘭妮雅(Melania Trump)上周也發布影片，介紹她為國宴進行的周密準備工作。此外，習近平抵達馬里蘭州安德魯斯聯合基地(Joint Base Andrews)時，川普本人打算親自在停機坪迎接。

items.title: AI基建商Accelevation赴美IPO估值最高達53.7億美元
items.title_en: AI Infrastructure Company Accelevation Plans U.S. IPO with Valuation Up to $5.37 B
paras: 2026年09月22日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI基礎設施供應商Accelevation(ACCV-US)周二表示，計畫透過美國首次公開募股(IPO)，尋求最高53.7億美元估值，加入AI投資熱潮帶動的上市潮。
總部位於美國俄亥俄州邁阿密斯堡的Accelevation，將與部分售股股東合計發行3,000萬股，每股發行價格介於20至24美元，最高募資規模達7.2億美元。
此次IPO承銷商包括Morgan Stanley、J.P. Morgan、Goldman Sachs及BofA Securities等金融機構。

Accelevation主要為資料中心設計、製造及安裝客製化電力與基礎設施，產品涵蓋遠端電力配電盤(RPP)、結構化布線、機櫃冷熱通道隔離系統，以及相關電力零組件，是AI基礎建設商機的相關供應商。隨著AI伺服器功率與機櫃密度提高，公司也提供適用於氣冷及液冷資料中心的模組化基礎設施，包括EvoFrame系統、隔離面板，以及用於熱隔離與機櫃管理的相關產品，服務範圍從傳統伺服器機櫃延伸至高密度AI運算環境。
除了設備製造，Accelevation也提供資料中心電力安裝服務，由內部持照電工負責施工，並具備快速設計、部署及緊急服務能力，使業務橫跨資料中心電力設備製造到現場建置。
公司於2017年由執行長Michael Rubiera創立，2025年1月獲私募股權公司Olympus Partners收購。
從營運數據來看，Accelevation截至2026年6月底的在手訂單約11億美元，反映資料中心基礎設施需求。公司2025年營收約4.48億美元，高於2024年的1.81億美元，年增率約148%；淨利則增加逾1倍至2,180萬美元。

paras_en: On September 22, 2026, AI infrastructure provider Accelevation (ACCV-US) announced that it plans to pursue a U.S. initial public offering (IPO) with a maximum valuation of $5.37 billion, joining the wave of listings driven by the AI investment boom.
Headquartered in Miami, Ohio, Accelevation will, together with certain selling shareholders, issue 30 million shares at a price range of $20 to $24 per share, raising up to $720 million.
The IPO will be underwritten by Morgan Stanley, J.P. Morgan, Goldman Sachs, and BofA Securities, among other financial institutions.

Accelevation specializes in designing, manufacturing, and installing custom power and infrastructure for data centers. Its product portfolio includes remote power distribution panels (RPP), structured cabling, rack cold/hot aisle isolation systems, and related power components, positioning it as a supplier for AI infrastructure opportunities. As AI server power and rack density increase, the company also offers modular infrastructure suitable for air‑cooled and liquid‑cooled data centers, such as the EvoFrame system, isolation panels, and products for thermal isolation and rack management, extending its services from traditional server racks to high‑density AI computing environments.

In addition to equipment manufacturing, Accelevation provides data‑center power installation services performed by in‑house licensed electricians, offering rapid design, deployment, and emergency support, thereby spanning the entire value chain from power equipment manufacturing to on‑site construction.
The company was founded in 2017 by CEO Michael Rubiera and was acquired by private‑equity firm Olympus Partners in January 2025.

Operational data shows that Accelevation had about $1.1 billion in orders on June 30, 2026, reflecting demand for data‑center infrastructure. Revenue for 2025 was approximately $448 million, up from $181 million in 2024, a year‑over‑year growth of about 148%; net profit more than doubled to $21.8 million.

items.title: DeepSeek赴聯合國安理會談AI風險！OpenAI、Anthropic罕見同場
items.title_en: DeepSeek Heads to UN Security Council to Discuss AI Risks; OpenAI and Anthropic Rarely Appear Together
paras: 中國AI新創DeepSeek本周將與OpenAI等業者一同向聯合國安全理事會說明人工智慧(AI)可能帶來的風險。在各國領袖齊聚紐約參加聯合國大會之際，AI安全與國際治理再度成為全球焦點。
《路透》周二(22日)援引兩名知情人士消息報導，由15個成員國組成的安理會將於周三召開會議，討論AI與國際安全。OpenAI執行長阿特曼預計出席說明，Anthropic也可能派高階主管與會。包括DeepSeek與月之暗面(Moonshot)在內的中國AI企業亦獲邀發言，但DeepSeek創辦人梁文鋒目前沒有出席計畫，且相關安排仍可能在最後一刻改變。
這場會議召開前數周，多名AI產業領袖才共同呼籲協調放慢日益強大的AI系統開發速度，警告先進模型可能很快具備自行改進能力，最終脫離人類控制。
負責維護國際和平與安全的聯合國安理會，2023年首度召開AI風險會議。中國當時警告，不應讓AI成為難以控制的「脫韁野馬」；美國則提醒，各國不得利用AI審查或壓迫人民。
聯合國秘書長古特瑞斯上周也警告，AI快速進步帶來的風險不容忽視。這項立場與川普政府有所分歧。川普主張現有防護措施已經足夠，並認為質疑AI發展將使中國受益。
中國官媒則批評，放慢AI開發的主張源自「冷戰劇本」，目的在維護華府對尖端科技的主導地位，並將北京排除在全球AI治理體系之外。相較OpenAI與Anthropic等美國前沿AI實驗室，中國主要模型開發商較少公開談論AI欺騙人類、逃避控制或造成災難性傷害的可能性，本月美國相關辯論升溫後，中國業者也大致保持沉默。
在本次安理會會議前，美國財政部長貝森特周一表示，美中高階官員已同意繼續就AI安全進行對話。相關共識是在川普與習近平本周於華盛頓會晤前達成。
paras_en: Chinese AI startup DeepSeek will this week join OpenAI and others in briefing the UN Security Council on potential risks of artificial intelligence (AI). As world leaders gather in New York for the UN General Assembly, AI safety and international governance are once again a global focus.

Reuters reported on Tuesday (the 22nd) citing two informed sources that the Security Council, composed of 15 member states, will hold a meeting on Wednesday to discuss AI and international security. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman is expected to attend to speak, and Anthropic may also send a senior executive. Chinese AI firms including DeepSeek and Moonshot have also been invited to speak, but DeepSeek founder Liang Wenfeng currently has no plans to attend, and the arrangements could still change at the last minute.

In the weeks leading up to the meeting, several AI industry leaders jointly called for coordinated slowing of the development pace of increasingly powerful AI systems, warning that advanced models could soon acquire self‑improvement capabilities and ultimately slip out of human control.

The UN Security Council, which is responsible for maintaining international peace and security, held its first AI‑risk meeting in 2023. At that time China warned that AI should not become an uncontrollable ‘runaway horse’; the United States cautioned that nations must not use AI to censor or oppress people.

UN Secretary‑General António Guterres also warned last week that the risks posed by AI’s rapid advancement cannot be ignored. This stance differs from that of the Trump administration, which argued that existing safeguards are sufficient and that questioning AI development would benefit China.

Chinese state media criticized the call to slow AI development as stemming from a ‘Cold War script’ aimed at preserving Washington’s dominance over cutting‑edge technology and excluding Beijing from a global AI governance framework. Compared with U.S. frontier AI labs such as OpenAI and Anthropic, China’s major model developers speak less publicly about the possibility that AI could deceive humans, evade control, or cause catastrophic harm; after the U.S. debate heated up this month, Chinese firms have largely remained silent.

U.S. Treasury Secretary Vincent said on Monday that senior U.S. and Chinese officials have agreed to continue dialogue on AI safety. The related consensus was reached before President Trump and Xi Jinping’s meeting in Washington this week.

items.title: 美股外強中乾？「這一幕」本世紀首見 上次發生在網路泡沫前
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Near Historic Highs Yet Show Century‑First Divergence; Last Seen Before the Dot‑Com Bubble
paras: 美股逼近歷史高點，盤面卻浮現本世紀首見的罕見背離。S&P 500(INX) 周一（21日）上漲逾1%、距52週新高不到1%，但創新低個股反而多於創新高者。上次出現相同情況是在1999年12月21日，距網路泡沫觸頂僅數月。
SentimenTrader創辦人兼NextGen News顧問Jason Goepfert在社群平台X指出，若再往前追溯，美股史上唯一另一次出現這種背離行情，是1929年7月23日。
換言之，這種指數逼近高點、個股卻大量跌至新低的局面，不僅是本世紀首見，在美股歷史上也極為罕見。
B. Riley Wealth首席市場策略師Art Hogan認為，這波行情的關鍵，在於目前的領漲力量究竟來自哪些族群。
標普500指數(INX) 的漲勢主要由通訊服務、資訊科技與非必需消費三大族群帶動，但其中只有資訊科技類股距離52週新高不到1%，通訊服務與非必需消費則仍分別較各自高點低4%與7%。
Hogan表示，近期領漲主力正艱難抵抗板塊輪動帶來的下行壓力，遭到拋售的個股則持續受賣壓壓制。
在目前的市場結構下，個股跌至新低，反而比攀上新高更加容易。這也意味著，大盤指數表面的強勢，並未反映多數個股的真實處境。
市場廣度進一步凸顯盤面分化。目前標普500指數成分股中，不到30%的股票站在50日移動平均線之上，顯示支撐指數上漲的股票範圍相當狹窄。即使大盤仍展現韌性，投資人實際面對的交易環境，已遠比指數呈現的景象艱困。
戰事、能源與升息壓力未解
Hogan進一步指出，如果中東局勢持續壓抑市場情緒，未來幾個月仍可能零星出現類似的結構性分化。只要戰事尚未結束、能源價格維持高檔，加上聯準會仍被迫持續升息，這波行情就很難真正迎來新的高點。
高盛資金流向專家Lee Coppersmith近期與客戶交流時也發現，投資人對當前市場愈來愈感到不安。
儘管市場面臨更鷹派的政策定價、持續的地緣政治不確定性，以及外界對人工智慧交易能否延續的爭論，大盤走勢仍相對堅挺，但指數之下的日常波動已愈來愈難應對。
投資情緒同步轉弱。衡量美股持股狀況的高盛情緒指標已降至負0.9，創下一年多來最低水準，反映投資人風險偏好明顯降溫。
整體而言，市場已消化不少宏觀與企業層面的多空消息，大盤指數雖仍具韌性，內部結構卻出現罕見裂痕。
當漲勢集中於少數權值股，多數個股則承受下行壓力，投資人想從個股中尋找超額報酬的難度，也正快速升高。
paras_en: U.S. stocks are approaching historic highs, but the market shows a rare divergence unseen this century. The S&P 500 (INX) rose more than 1% on Monday (the 21st), staying within 1% of its 52‑week high, yet more stocks are hitting new lows than new highs. The last time this occurred was December 21, 1999, just months before the peak of the internet bubble.
Jason Goepfert, founder of SentimenTrader and advisor to NextGen News, noted on X that the only other time in U.S. market history a similar divergence appeared was on July 23, 1929.
In other words, the situation where the index nears a peak while many individual stocks plunge to new lows is not only a first of the century but also extremely rare in U.S. market history.
Art Hogan, chief market strategist at B. Riley Wealth, believes the key to this rally lies in which groups are driving the leadership gains today.

The S&P 500’s advance is being led by three sectors – communication services, information technology and consumer discretionary – but only the information‑technology stocks are within 1% of their 52‑week highs; communication services and consumer discretionary remain about 4% and 7% below their respective peaks.
Hogan said the current leaders are struggling to withstand the downward pressure from sector rotation, and the stocks being sold off continue to face selling pressure.

In today’s market structure, it is easier for individual stocks to fall to new lows than to climb to new highs, meaning the index’s apparent strength does not reflect the real condition of most stocks.

Market breadth further highlights the split. Less than 30% of S&P 500 constituents are above their 50‑day moving average, indicating a very narrow base supporting the index’s rise. Even though the broad market remains resilient, investors face a trading environment far tougher than the index suggests.
War, energy and rate‑hike pressures remain unresolved

Hogan added that if Middle‑East tensions keep dampening sentiment, sporadic structural splits could reappear over the next few months. As long as conflicts persist, energy prices stay high and the Fed is forced to keep raising rates, this rally will struggle to reach a new peak.
Goldman Sachs capital‑flows specialist Lee Coppersmith recently told clients that investors are growing increasingly uneasy about the market.

Despite a more hawkish policy pricing, ongoing geopolitical uncertainty, and debate over whether AI‑driven trading can sustain its momentum, the broad market remains relatively sturdy, yet daily volatility beneath the index is becoming harder to manage.
Investor sentiment is weakening in tandem. Goldman’s U.S. equity sentiment gauge has slipped to –0.9, its lowest level in over a year, reflecting a clear cooling of risk appetite.
Overall, the market has already priced in much of the macro and corporate news; while the index retains resilience, its internal structure shows a rare crack.
When the rally is concentrated in a few heavyweight stocks and most others face downward pressure, the difficulty of finding excess returns in individual stocks is rising rapidly.

items.title: 〈台幣〉交投熱絡處續強格局 升值5分收31.708元
items.title_en: New Taiwan Dollar Keeps Strong Appreciation Trend, Gains 0.05 to Close at 31.708
paras: 新台幣今(22)日維持續強升值格局，終場收在31.708元，升值5分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值達20.13億美元相對大量區。
新台幣今日以31.74元、升值1.8分開出後，最高來到31.658元，全日均處升值態勢，高低價差9分。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元續強升值達0.8%，新台幣收升0.16%，星元和人民幣則貶0.05%左右，日元和泰銖續挫逾0.2%，美元指數反彈達0.15%。
元大投顧表示，隨著國際原油、債券殖利率回落，市場風險偏好轉強，帶動科技族群走揚。
國泰證期研究部也說明，中東局勢雖因青年運動攻擊沙國而緊張，但川普釋出與伊朗會面意願，油價回落且 10 年期美債殖利率降至 4.951%、30 年期降至 5.284%，加上美國財長貝森特已會晤何立峰，為即將登場的川習會鋪路，舒緩市場對通膨升息及地緣政治的疑慮。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar maintained its strong appreciation trend today (22nd), closing at 31.708, up 0.05, with Taipei foreign‑exchange brokerage firms’ transaction volume reaching US$2.013 billion in the large‑volume segment.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.74, up 0.018, then rose to a high of 31.658, staying in appreciation throughout the day, with a high‑low spread of 0.09.

Among major Asian currencies, the Korean won continued to appreciate by 0.8%, the New Taiwan dollar rose 0.16%, the Singapore dollar and the Chinese yuan each weakened about 0.05%, the Japanese yen and Thai baht each fell more than 0.2%, and the U.S. dollar index rebounded 0.15%.
Yuanta Investment Advisory said that as international crude‑oil prices and bond yields retreat, market risk appetite strengthens, boosting the technology sector.

Cathay Securities Research explained that although Middle‑East tensions have risen due to a youth‑movement attack on Saudi Arabia, President Trump signaled willingness to meet Iran, oil prices have fallen and the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield has dropped to 4.951% and the 30‑year to 5.284%. In addition, U.S. Treasury Secretary Besson has met with He Lifeng, paving the way for the upcoming Trump‑Xi summit and easing market concerns about inflation‑driven rate hikes and geopolitical risks.

items.title: 油價回落與半導體出口強勁 韓元大漲1.5%領跑亞幣
items.title_en: Oil price drop and strong semiconductor exports, Won jumps 1.5% leading Asian currencies
paras: 受到國際油價急跌、南韓出口數據強勁及外資湧入等多重利多帶動，韓元兌美元匯率周二(22日)顯著走揚，韓元單日漲幅一度擴大至1.5%，來到1,352.90韓元兌1美元，創下五周以來最大單日升幅，表現大幅跑贏其他亞洲貨幣。
市場數據顯示，韓元兌美元當日開盤報1,371韓元，較前一交易日收盤價升約0.67%。隨後匯率迅速突破1,360韓元關卡。分析人士指出，適逢中秋假期臨近，南韓主要出口企業集中拋售美元，加上外資大舉買入南韓股票與美股強勁反彈，帶動整體市場風險偏好回溫。
國際局勢方面，美伊局勢出現對話跡象，國際油價連續3日下挫，布蘭特原油期貨下跌3.4%至每桶100.34美元，西德州原油(WTI)亦重挫4.5%跌破100美元關卡，帶來股市及韓元匯市利多。
南韓周一公布9月前20天出口額年增高達78%，其中半導體出貨大幅激增259%，帶來龐大的美元資金流入。此外，美元買盤減弱，美國10年期國債殖利率回落至5%以下，緩解了美元的升值壓力。
友利銀行(Woori Bank)分析師閔庚源表示，風險偏好回升有利於出口商結匯拋售美元，進一步拉低匯率。然而，全球高利率環境與美元整體強勢，仍可能是限制韓元後續升值空間的潛在因素。
paras_en: Benefiting from a sharp fall in international oil prices, robust South Korean export data and inflows of foreign capital, the Korean won surged significantly against the US dollar on Tuesday (the 22nd). The one‑day gain briefly widened to 1.5%, reaching 1,352.90 won per dollar, marking the largest single‑day rise in five weeks and far outpacing other Asian currencies.

Market data showed the won opened at 1,371 per dollar, about 0.67% higher than the previous close. The rate then quickly broke the 1,360‑won barrier. Analysts noted that with the Mid‑Autumn holiday approaching, major South Korean exporters were selling dollars en masse, while foreign investors were buying South Korean stocks and US equities rebounded strongly, boosting overall market risk appetite.

On the geopolitical front, signs of dialogue emerged between the US and Iran, and international oil prices fell for three consecutive days. Brent crude futures dropped 3.4% to $100.34 a barrel, and West Texas Intermediate slid 4.5% below the $100 mark, providing a boost to both equity markets and the won exchange market.

South Korea reported on Monday that export value for the first 20 days of September rose 78% year‑on‑year, with semiconductor shipments surging 259%, bringing in a massive inflow of US dollars. At the same time, dollar buying pressure eased and the yield on the US 10‑year Treasury fell below 5%, relieving upward pressure on the dollar.

Woori Bank analyst Min Gyeong‑won said that the revival of risk appetite benefits exporters who convert earnings and sell dollars, further pushing the won lower. However, the global high‑interest‑rate environment and the overall strength of the dollar could still limit the won’s upside potential.

items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Rises to Near 8‑Week High; Euro in Focus Over German Politics
paras: 美元周一(19日)小幅走升，來到近8周高點，延續上周強勁漲勢，此前聯準會(Fed)進行了 3年多來首次升息。另一方面，日元在日本銀行(BoJ)決定收緊貨幣政策後，先前一波猛烈跌勢暫歇，歐元則因德國最新民調結果出爐而受矚。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報100.43，創7月29日以來最高。
本月市場最受關注議題之一，就是各大央行的升息行動。歐洲銀行(ECB)、聯準會與日本銀行近期都採取升息措施，且都提到了能源價格推動的通膨壓力。
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)上周在記者會上表示，「明確的事實就是通膨太高，而且已經持續太久。」
此前，聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)一致投票決定，將聯邦資金利率從3.50%-3.75%上調至 3.75%-4.00%。
此外，聯準會更新後的「經濟預測摘要」顯示，至少有12名FOMC委員認為今年還會再升息一次。
在FOMC做出升息決定之前，市場對聯準會升息的預期機率曾飆升至90%。推動市場預期的因素包括：油價急升、美國經濟數據，以及債券市場持續遭到拋售。尤其是固定收益市場投資人對這次升息反應正面，因他們認為這顯示聯準會沒有在通膨問題上落後於形勢。
Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management投資長Brent Schutte表示，「經濟的強勁表現，很可能就是聯準會認為可以升息的原因。但我們也提醒，升息的目的就是要放慢經濟成長速度。因此也會提高政策過度緊縮的風險，因為升息對經濟的影響延遲且不均。」
他進一步表示，「你們或許還記得，聯準會上一輪在2022年和2023年的升息，造成了經濟出現明顯分化。」當時，對利率較敏感的產業、企業及消費者面臨較大壓力，即使整體經濟仍持續成長。
歐元承受德國政治局勢轉變壓力
歐元兌美元下跌0.2%，至1歐元兌1.1463 美元。
歐洲交易市場正在消化周末公布的選舉預測結果。結果顯示，極右翼政黨「德國另類選擇黨」(AfD)在德國東北部的州選舉中取得領先。
這項具歷史意義的結果，直接打擊了德國總理梅爾茨(Friedrich Merz)領導的主流保守派聯盟，也讓歐洲股市面臨新的政治風險。
德銀的Jim Reid表示，「在極右派方面，AfD持續獲得更多支持，主要訴求包括反移民與反建制，尤其是在德國東部地區。」他也指出，左派政黨似乎則成功利用了民眾對住房負擔能力、生活成本以及社會不平等的擔憂。
他補充，「對市場而言，眼前最直接的影響並不是德國國家政策會立刻改變，而是德國政治中心進一步弱化，也再次提醒市場，推動歐洲政治兩極化的力量仍然存在。」
日元在升息、「利率檢查」後走弱
日元周一走弱，延續上周約2%猛烈跌勢。此前日銀公布利率決策後，日元跌至數周低點。
美元兌日元上漲0.3%，來到157.36日元。
日本金融市場周一因三天國定假期而休市。
由於假期期間流動性較低，全球交易員高度警戒日本政府可能進行外匯干預。過去在市場流動性不足的情況下，央行進場買進本國貨幣可能造成更大的價格波動。
讓市場對干預的擔憂進一步升高的是，《日本經濟新聞》上周五報導，日銀曾進行所謂的 「利率檢查」。這是指央行官員打電話給外匯交易部門，詢問市場上實際的買賣價。
日本銀行上周五將借貸成本提高至1.25%，創下31年來最高水準。
然而，兩名委員投下偏寬鬆政策的反對票，加上日銀總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)強調政策需要進行預先性的調整，最初反而引發市場「利多出盡」反應。
這也迫使日本當局開始採取更積極的口頭警告及「利率檢查」，以支撐日元匯率。

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Monday (the 19th), reaching a near‑8‑week high and continuing last week’s strong rally after the Federal Reserve delivered its first rate hike in more than three years. Meanwhile, the yen’s sharp slide eased after the Bank of Japan tightened policy, and the euro drew attention following the release of Germany’s latest poll results.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.2% to 100.43, its highest level since July 29.

One of the market’s top topics this month is the rate‑hike actions of major central banks. The European Central Bank, the Federal Reserve and the Bank of Japan have all recently raised rates and all cited inflation pressure from energy prices.
Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said at a press conference last week that “the clear fact is that inflation is too high and has been too persistent.”
Earlier, the Federal Open Market Committee voted unanimously to lift the federal funds rate range from 3.50‑3.75% to 3.75‑4.00%.
In addition, the Fed’s updated Summary of Economic Projections showed that at least 12 FOMC members expect another rate hike this year.

Before the FOMC’s decision, market expectations for a Fed hike had surged to 90%. Drivers of that expectation included a sharp rise in oil prices, U.S. economic data and continued bond‑market selling. Fixed‑income investors reacted positively, seeing the hike as evidence that the Fed is not lagging behind inflation pressures.

Brent Schutte, Chief Investment Officer at Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management, said, “The economy’s strong performance is likely why the Fed feels it can raise rates. But we remind that the purpose of tightening is to slow growth, which raises the risk of overtightening because the impact of rate hikes is delayed and uneven.”

He added, “You may recall the Fed’s previous tightening cycles in 2022‑2023 caused a clear split in the economy.” At that time, rate‑sensitive industries, firms and consumers felt heightened pressure even as overall growth continued.
Euro Under Pressure From Shifts in German Politics
The euro fell 0.2% against the dollar to $1.1463 per euro.
European markets are digesting the election‑forecast results released over the weekend, which showed the far‑right Alternative for Germany (AfD) leading in state elections in Germany’s northeast.
The historic outcome directly hit the mainstream conservative Union bloc led by Chancellor Friedrich Merz and added new political risk to European equities.

Jim Reid of Deutsche Bank said, “On the far‑right, the AfD is gaining more support, driven mainly by anti‑immigration and anti‑establishment messages, especially in eastern Germany.” He also noted that left‑wing parties seem to be capitalising on public concerns about housing affordability, living costs and social inequality.

He added, “For markets, the most immediate impact isn’t an immediate change in German national policy, but a further weakening of Germany’s political centre, reminding investors that forces driving European political polarisation remain present.”
Yen Weakens After Rate Hike and “Rate Check”
The yen weakened on Monday, extending last week’s roughly 2% plunge. Earlier, the yen fell to a multi‑week low after the BOJ announced its rate decision.
The dollar rose 0.3% against the yen to 157.36 yen.
Japan’s financial markets were closed on Monday for a three‑day national holiday.

Because liquidity is thin during the holiday, global traders are on high alert for possible foreign‑exchange intervention by the Japanese government. In past low‑liquidity episodes, central‑bank purchases of the domestic currency have amplified price swings.

Market worries about intervention were heightened after Nikkei reported last Friday that the BOJ had carried out a so‑called “rate check,” meaning officials called FX desks to ask about actual bid‑ask prices in the market.
The Bank of Japan raised its borrowing cost to 1.25% last Friday, the highest level in 31 years.

However, two board members cast votes for a more accommodative stance, and Governor Kazuo Ueda stressed that policy needed a pre‑emptive adjustment, initially prompting a “no‑more‑good‑news” reaction in the market.
That forced Japanese authorities to adopt more aggressive verbal warnings and conduct “rate checks” to support the yen’s exchange rate.

paras: 瑞銀資產管理(UBS Asset Management)全球主權與貨幣固定收益主管Kevin Zhao表示，若日本政府再度出手干預匯市、拉抬日元，將是賣出日元的好機會。他並不認為日銀上周五升息，意味貨幣政策已明顯轉向鷹派。
Zhao今年稍早原本加碼持有日元，但在美日兩國7月大規模聯手買進日元後賣出部位，如今正等待下一次進場賣出的時機。當時日元兌美元一度貶至約164日元，創40年來最低水準。
日銀上周升息，並宣告貨幣政策已進入「新階段」，但Zhao認為，無論是進一步升息或政府再次干預，都不足以讓投資人相信日元能夠持續走強。他直言，日本維持弱勢日元的根本政策並未改變，美元兌日元接下來可能繼續攀升，日本當局最終仍會再度干預，否則恐怕顏面盡失。
日元本月初一度因市場預期日銀將加快升息而反彈，但上周五升息後支撐有限，匯價再度朝164日元關卡靠近。日本當局隨後向市場參與者進行匯率「詢價」，這項行動通常被視為正式進場買進日元的前兆。
目前交易員押注日銀至明年6月最多還會升息3次，但也預期聯準會(Fed)同期將升息相同次數，意味美日利差未必明顯縮小。Zhao反問，若Fed降息期間美元兌日元都未能大幅回落，如今Fed轉向升息，日元又怎麼可能顯著升值？
Zhao預期，即使日本通膨隨經濟成長升溫，日銀未來幾個月仍會放慢緊縮腳步。日本首相高市早苗延續前首相安倍晉三的「安倍經濟學」路線，堅持透過財政支出支撐經濟。在股市大漲、名目國內生產毛額(GDP)成長及政府債務龐大的情況下，低利率仍符合政府與日銀利益。他強調，「安倍經濟學從來不等於強勢日元」。
paras_en: UBS Asset Management’s global sovereign and currency fixed‑income head Kevin Zhao said that if the Japanese government intervenes again in the FX market to prop up the yen, it would be a good opportunity to sell the yen. He does not believe that the Bank of Japan’s rate hike last Friday signals a clear hawkish shift in monetary policy.

Zhao had increased his yen holdings earlier this year, but sold those positions after the United States and Japan jointly bought large amounts of yen in July. He is now waiting for the next chance to re‑enter and sell. At that time the yen fell to about ¥164 per dollar, its lowest level in 40 years.

The BOJ raised rates last week and announced that monetary policy had entered a “new stage,” but Zhao thinks that whether the BOJ hikes further or the government intervenes again, neither will convince investors that the yen can stay strong. He bluntly says Japan’s fundamental policy of keeping a weak yen has not changed, the dollar‑yen pair may keep climbing, and the authorities will eventually intervene again or risk losing face.

The yen briefly rebounded earlier this month on expectations that the BOJ would accelerate rate hikes, but the support faded after the Friday hike and the exchange rate moved back toward the ¥164 level. Japanese authorities then sent a “price inquiry” to market participants, an action usually seen as a prelude to officially buying yen.

Traders currently bet that the BOJ may raise rates up to three more times by June next year, while also expecting the Fed to raise rates the same number of times, meaning the US‑Japan rate differential may not narrow much. Zhao retorts that if the dollar‑yen pair did not fall significantly during the Fed’s rate‑cut cycle, how could the yen appreciate markedly now that the Fed is back to tightening?

Zhao expects that even if Japanese inflation rises with economic growth, the BOJ will slow its tightening over the next few months. Prime Minister Kishida continues former Prime Minister Abe’s “Abenomics” approach, insisting on fiscal spending to support the economy. With a booming stock market, nominal GDP growth and massive government debt, low rates still suit both the government and the BOJ. He stresses that “Abenomics has never meant a strong yen.”

items.title: 南韓央行啟動24小時韓元交割網路試點
items.title_en: South Korea's Central Bank Launches 24-Hour Won Settlement Network Pilot
paras: 南韓中央銀行(BOK)周一(21日)正式啟動首個24小時韓元交割網路的試營運。此系統於當地時間周一上午9點開始運行，首波由國民銀行(KB Kookmin)、友利銀行(Woori)、韓亞銀行(Hana)與新韓銀行(Shinhan)等四家南韓本土商業銀行率先參與。
在開運首晨約9點30分，兩家參試本土機構成功完成首筆測試交易，金額約為14億韓元(約合100萬美元)。
這項全天候交割機制在工作日實行24小時不間斷運作，僅在周末與國定假日休市。其最大特色在於允許境外外國投資人透過「韓元業務註冊外國機構」(RFI-K)開設的帳戶，在其所在地的當地營業時間直接辦理韓元交易結算與交割，無須親自在南韓境內金融機構開立帳戶。
此舉顯著改善了過去歐美投資人因時差問題而面臨的債券與資產交割延宕困境。
此次試營運為南韓政府推動「韓元國際化路線圖」及外匯改革計畫的重要推手。先前南韓在岸韓元對美元外匯市場已於7月邁入全天候交易，本次交割網路補足了配套支付基礎設施，旨在提升韓元的國際地位，並積極爭取納入 MSCI 發達市場指數。
這一網路預計經約3個月測試後，於2027年1月正式上線營運，屆時將擴大邀請全球主要外資銀行及金融機構全面接入。
paras_en: South Korea's central bank (BOK) officially launched the pilot operation of its first 24‑hour won settlement network on Monday (the 21st). The system began running at 9:00 a.m. local time, with four domestic commercial banks – KB Kookmin, Woori, Hana and Shinhan – participating in the initial wave.

Around 9:30 a.m. on the first morning of operation, two of the participating domestic institutions successfully completed the first test transaction, amounting to roughly 1.4 billion won (about US$1 million).

The round‑the‑clock settlement mechanism operates continuously 24 hours on business days, closing only on weekends and public holidays. Its key feature is that foreign investors can settle and deliver won transactions directly during their own local business hours through accounts opened via the "Registered Foreign Institution for Won Business" (RFI‑K), without needing to open an account at a Korean financial institution.
This move markedly eases the bond and asset settlement delays that European and U.S. investors previously faced due to time‑zone differences.

The pilot supports South Korea's government push for a "Won Internationalisation Roadmap" and foreign‑exchange reform, following the launch of all‑day on‑shore won‑USD trading in July. The new settlement network adds the necessary payment infrastructure to boost the won's global standing and to help secure inclusion in the MSCI Developed Markets index.

The network is expected to undergo about three months of testing before going live in January 2027, at which point it will invite major global foreign banks and financial institutions to connect fully.

items.title: 〈台幣〉風險情緒轉強 升值5分收31.758元
items.title_en: NTD risk sentiment turns strong, gains 0.05 and closes at 31.758
paras: 新台幣今(21)日全日維持偏強走勢，終場收在31.758元，升值5分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值擴大至22.67億美元。
新台幣今日以31.79元、升值1.8分開出後，最高來到31.716元，全日高低價差7.4分。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元飆升超過1%，新台幣收升0.16%，泰銖升逾0.1%，人民幣升值0.05%上下，星元在平盤附近狹幅震盪，日元則逆勢貶近0.2%，美元指數小跌0.05%左右。
元大投顧認為，聯準會通過升息 1 碼將目標區調高至 3.75%到 4%，也是 2023 年 7 月來首次升息，但聯準會主席華許表示經濟依然強勁，可在不損害就業市場下恢復物價穩定，因此，台股在各項變數漸漸釐清後，可望展開季底作帳行情，惟個股將強弱分明。
統一投顧則指出，上周全球央行周和美日升息後，美國10年債殖利率止漲，緩和通膨擔憂和繼續升息的緊張情緒，而儘管中東地緣政治局勢動盪、國際債市與匯市波動加劇、AI 放緩雜音增多，但整體風險可控，再考量美伊再次出現重啟談判曙光，可提振市場風險偏好。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar stayed on the stronger side throughout the day on the 21st, ending at NT$31.758, a gain of 0.05, with the turnover at Taipei foreign‑exchange brokers expanding to US$2.267 billion.
After opening at NT$31.79, up 0.018, the NTD peaked at NT$31.716, with a daily high‑low range of 0.074.

Among the major Asian currencies, the Korean won surged more than 1%, the NTD rose 0.16%, the Thai baht gained over 0.1%, the Chinese yuan appreciated about 0.05%, the Singapore dollar hovered near flat, the Japanese yen fell about 0.2% against the trend, and the US dollar index slipped roughly 0.05%.

Yuanta Securities believes that the Fed’s 1‑percentage‑point rate hike, raising the target range to 3.75%‑4%, marks the first increase since July 2023. Fed Chair Jerome Powell said the economy remains strong and price stability can be restored without harming the labor market, so after variables are clarified, Taiwan’s stock market could see end‑of‑quarter accounting activity, though individual stocks will show clear winners and losers.

Unified Securities notes that after last week’s global central‑bank meetings and US‑Japan rate hikes, the US 10‑year Treasury yield stalled, easing inflation concerns and the tension over further hikes. Despite geopolitical turbulence in the Middle East, heightened volatility in international bond and FX markets, and growing noise around a slowdown in AI, overall risk remains manageable. Moreover, renewed hopes of renewed US‑Iran talks could boost market risk appetite.

items.title: 升息失望與干預疑慮交織 日元在連假流動性低迷下恐加劇波動
items.title_en: Rate Hike Disappointment and Intervention Concerns Intertwine, Yen May See Heightened Volatility Amid Low Liquidity During Holiday
paras: 日元對美元在上周重挫逾2%後，於周一(21日)盤初暫告企穩，報156.85日元兌1美元。然而，隨著日本「白銀周」到來，交易員擔心，在市場流動性大幅下降後，恐加劇匯率波動。
日本央行上周五雖然將政策利率調升至1.25%，創下31年來新高，然而會中出現2票反對，加上總裁植田和男並未提供明確的未來升息指引，使寄望鷹派立場的投資人感到失望，引發日元走跌，盤中一度下挫1.3%。
隨後市場傳出日本官方進行「匯率檢查」(rate check)，雖稍微收斂跌幅並收於156.88日元，但依然凸顯出匯市強烈的干預疑慮與風險。
目前，日本正逢「白銀周」連續休假，市場交易流動性大幅下降，投資人對官方干預保持高度戒備。分析指出，流動性較低時易引發劇烈波動，但也為當局介入提供放大效果的契機，一如今年4月至5月黃金周期間日元跌破160關卡後的干預舉措。
財務省數據顯示，日本當局於7月下旬至8月26日期間，曾砸下創紀錄的15.4兆日元進行美日協調干預，帶動日元從7月接近164的40年低點，一度強勢反彈至9月初的152.89高峰。
然而，美日央行政策分歧再次為日元帶來下行壓力。聯準會近期發出鷹派訊號，市場預計10月繼續升息的機率升至55%；反觀日央行10月升息的機率，已被掉期市場定價降至20%以下。
監管數據顯示，投機客在日央行會前將日元淨多頭部位推升至97億美元(創2025年7月以來新高)。但在日央行政策指引缺乏明確鷹派訊號的情況下，這批多頭押注正面臨極大回檔風險。
paras_en: The yen slipped more than 2% against the dollar last week, but on Monday (the 21st) it briefly steadied in early trade at 156.85 yen per $1.

Although the Bank of Japan raised its policy rate to 1.25% last Friday – a 31‑year high – two votes were cast against the move and Governor Kazuo Ueda gave no clear guidance on future hikes, leaving investors who had hoped for a hawkish stance disappointed and sending the yen down, at one point falling 1.3% intraday.

Subsequently, reports emerged that Japanese authorities were conducting a “rate check,” which trimmed the decline slightly and closed at 156.88 yen, but the episode still underscored strong market fears of possible intervention.

Japan is currently in the middle of “Silver Week,” a string of holidays that has sharply reduced market liquidity, prompting investors to stay on high alert for official action. Analysts note that low‑liquidity environments can trigger sharp moves, yet they also give authorities a bigger impact if they choose to step in, as seen after the yen fell below the 160‑yen barrier during the gold‑price rally in April‑May this year.

Ministry of Finance data show that Japanese authorities intervened with a record‑breaking 15.4 trillion yen in coordinated US‑Japan action from late July to August 26, lifting the yen from near a 40‑year low of about 164 in July to a strong rebound of 152.89 in early September.

However, policy divergence between the Fed and the BOJ is again weighing on the yen. The Fed’s recent hawkish signals have pushed the market’s odds of another October hike to 55%, while the BOJ’s chance of an October hike has been priced by the swap market at below 20%.

Regulatory data indicate that speculators pushed net long positions on the yen to $9.7 billion ahead of the BOJ meeting – a high not seen since July 2025 – but with the BOJ offering no clear hawkish guidance, those long bets now face a substantial risk of a sharp unwind.
